tagline: Route the light. Build the jewel.

intros.lapidary: The Lapidary: spend Glints on gems, Settings and services before the next Night.
intros.settings: Settings change the rules for the rest of the run. Tap one to read it.
intros.eclipse: An Eclipse: a hard rule until dawn. Beat it for a gem with an Inclusion.
intros.cabinet: The Cabinet keeps every Inclusion gem you end a run with. Lend some to your next run.

unlocks.dawnWithBothApertures: Score a Dawn with both Apertures lit.
unlocks.cabinetAllStones: Keep all 7 stones in the Cabinet.
unlocks.winWithPouchAtMost: Win with a pouch of {pouch} or fewer.
